n1c83f5828f.headline: 'Abenomics' doubts drive foreigners off Japanese stocks, volatility spikes
n1c83f5828f.summary: Foreign investors are exiting Japanese stocks due to concerns about the economy and policy decisions, increasing market volatility.
n1c83f5828f.why: 'Abenomics' policies have been central to Japan's economic strategy; investor sentiment affects equity flows and market stability.
n1c83f5828f.why_moved: Investor concerns about Japan's economic outlook and policy effectiveness triggered foreign selling, increasing volatility and downward pressure on stocks.
